ubatch lines (model passes) of the request

how the parent slot was chosen (slot line): LRU, LCP or id
census slot structure of the model that reproduces the ubatches: P<seqs> prefix pass, F whole prompt in one pass, S<seqs> suffix pass, separated by spaces; ? = no model reproduces them
passes of that model: P<tokens>, F<tokens>, S<seqs>x<tokens per seq>, joined by +; a leading ~ = rebuilt from the observed ubatches only

model expected for the cache mode of the log (kv_unified of the load_model line): unified or seq
True when the expected model reproduces the observed ubatches

True when the observed ubatch count is above pred_ub
n_dec minus fixed_dec (positive = more llama_decode calls than the fixed order)
